name: 1942 PSG filters and mix
drawing: MAIN AMP., sheet 84100-01A-2 4/8 of the 1942 schematics (doc 27d4fd762a04, PDF p. 4) -- via MAME's netlist, compared with it
revision: 1942 A board (84100-01A), main amp sheet: each of the two AY-3-8910s' six channels through a 10K load, a 10uF capacitor and a 220K mixing resistor into the 2K volume pot, then to the MB3731 power amplifier's input.
coverage: 0 ICs, 22 other parts and 17 nets over 45 pins. Converted from MAME's netlist and compared with the sheet, up to the MB3731 amplifier's pins 1 and 5; the amplifier, its supply and the edge connector are not in MAME. It has no ICs, so there is no board view: the netlist and the bill of materials carry it.

origin.sourceLabel: The conversion, every change from MAME's file logged
origin.what: The netlist is MAME's -- written to simulate this board, from its schematics -- converted here into the board's own nets, with MAME's simulation stand-ins undone and, where this site holds the schematic, checked and corrected against it. The board view, chip lookup and bill of materials are made from it.
